links.outcome: Readability (FRE, LIX), patient-rated clarity, structure and usefulness, and comprehension accuracy
links.effect: FRE 48.4 ± 5.0 vs. 22.9 ± 5.2 (p < 0.0001); LIX 48.3 ± 3.2 vs. 59.2 ± 2.5 (p = 0.004); comprehension e.g., MRI 80.3% vs. 53.7% (p < 0.001); ratings higher (p < 0.001); no loss of medical information observed
links.quote: Simplified reports achieved significantly higher readability (FRE 48.4 ± 5.0 vs. 22.9 ± 5.2; p < 0.0001; LIX 48.3 ± 3.2 vs. 59.2 ± 2.5; p = 0.004).

design_hint: reading-level simplification prompt for patient-facing reports
